description: Return 4 style options (style_id, label, preview image_url, source library|yours|brand, description) for a visual format. ALWAYS call this before the first visual of a request (infographic, carousel, image, quote card, motion, video), show the user the 4 images as a labelled 2x2, and ask them to pick one, 'show 4 more' (page+1) or 'try another format' (other_formats). Then pass the chosen style_id to the generate tool. Read-only; never returns other creators' names, avatars or original posts.

author_id.description: Creator whose approved designs and brand styles are included.

name: bamf.list_style_options
